patthana17.15:1.1: Kusalaṃ maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo namaggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana17.15:2.1: Kusalaṃ maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo namaggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.15:3.1: Kusalaṃ maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo namaggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
